about_lead: Founded by Widler Junior Phanor, Phanor Distribution Inc. was not born in a boardroom, but behind the counter of a neighbourhood butcher shop.
about_p1: 8 years ago, Widler began with a single goal: to master the art of the cut. From understanding muscles, marbling, and dry-ageing, he forged an expertise few possess. But the butcher's counter was too small for his vision. He saw how the industry worked — the middlemen, the margins, the quality loss in transit — and decided to rebuild it all.
about_p2: Phanor Distribution was created to bridge the gap between farm and chef's table. By eliminating compromises, Widler built a vertically integrated logistics network. Today, the company supplies Montréal's most demanding restaurants, premium markets, and households that refuse mediocrity.
about_quote: "WE DON'T SELL MEAT. WE SELL PRECISION, RELIABILITY, AND RESPECT FOR THE PRODUCT."
about_p3: From the Book Honors division that elevates catering to a Michelin level, to the Select Bundles that bring restaurant quality to families, Widler's empire continues to expand. The crown and bull of our logo are not just a symbol — it's a seal of sovereignty over the industry.
